description: This Java source file defines the PoliciesValidator class, which implements validation logic for policies within a policy management system. It checks whether a set of policy entries grants the minimum required permissions to subjects by analyzing resource effects such as granted and revoked permissions.

classes.name: PoliciesValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing a validator for policies. It verifies if policies grant the minimum required permissions to subjects and provides validation status and reasons.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new PoliciesValidator instance with a given set of policy entries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs validation on the policy entries to check for at least one subject with the required permissions.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an optional string explaining the reason for validation failure, if any.

methods.name: hasPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if a given policy entry grants the minimum required permissions on the root resource.

methods.name: hasPermissionRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a given policy entry revokes the minimum required permissions on the root resource.
